mpd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MPD server to connect to.

mpd_port.description: Port number of the MPD server.

mpd_password.description: Password required by MPD for authentication. Leave empty if none is configured on the server.

mpd_socket_path.description: Absolute path to the MPD Unix socket (alternative to host/port). Leave empty to use TCP connection.

mixer_volume.description: Initial volume level (0–100) for the client mixer UI.

auto_connect.description: Whether the client should automatically connect to MPD on startup.

music_directory.description: Path to the music library directory for UI display purposes (e.g., file browser or playlist editing).

cover_art_enabled.description: Enable fetching and display of embedded or file-based cover art in the UI.

custom_art_filenames.description: List of cover art filenames to search for in album directories (in order of preference).

log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none) to 4 (debug). Higher values produce more detailed logs.

systemd_notify.description: Enable systemd readiness notification for proper service lifecycle integration (advanced).
